body.name: covariance-inverted polarity confidence set
body.construction: Let \(B_n=\{\Theta\in\mathcal K:\lVert\Theta-S_n\rVert_F\le r_n\}\). Set \(\Gamma_n=\bigcup_{\Theta\in B_n}\mathcal P(\Theta)\) when \(B_n\ne\varnothing\), and \(\Gamma_n=\mathcal P(\Theta_{j_n(S_n)})\) otherwise, where \(j_n(S)=\min\{j:\lVert\Theta_j-S\rVert_F<\rho(S)+1/n\}\) and \(\rho(S)=\inf_{\Theta\in\mathcal K}\lVert\Theta-S\rVert_F\).
